subject: Segmentation & capacity upgrade at contract rollforward - NovaGen Therapeutics
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@novagen.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novagen.com, ctomike@novagen.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion ask ahead of renewal — analytics VPC + on-prem edge node

Hi Vivek,

We're approaching our contract rollforward on Aug 1 and have a couple of asks from engineering and procurement that we want to resolve before signing. Short version: we need an additional isolated VPC for analytics (dedicated cluster, no shared KV cache), plus one on-prem inference node at our Boston research site for low-latency PHI processing.

Key constraints:
- Analytics VPC: separate tenancy, EU data residency not required (US region), strict audit window (SOC2 evidence in next 30 days).
- On-prem node: air-gapped install option, KMS integration required, target go-live by Nov 1.
- Commercial: they're asking if a 24-month rollforward (instead of 12) can reduce unit pricing for the on-prem hardware + cluster reservation. Procurement wants a bundled pricing option + SOW to review.

Can you confirm feasibility and high-level timelines? If possible, please include an estimated delta to our current committed capacity and a draft SOW to share with procurement. I can coordinate internal stakeholders once we have ballpark numbers.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaGen Therapeutics
phone: +1 617 555 0112
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novagen.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion ask ahead of renewal — analytics VPC + on-prem edge node

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear ask. High-level: doable. I've sketched a mutual action plan below and attached a first-pass SOW and topology diagram for procurement and your architects.

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) Week 1 (now): Redwood provides draft SOW, topology, and ballpark cost delta.
2) Week 2: NovaGen review (procurement + engineering) — clarify KMS/HSM requirements for on-prem node.
3) Week 3: Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence window (we'll surface logs and controls).
4) Week 4: Final SOW and pricing cadence; insert 24-month commitment option for pricing review.
5) Target signature: by Aug 1 to align with rollforward; provisioning of VPC in ~3 weeks post-signature; on-prem delivery timeline depends on customer hardware lead times (we can offer a managed appliance or a BYOH install).

Delta summary (ballpark):
- Isolated analytics VPC (1 dedicated cluster, 4 A100 equiv): +~$45k/month reserved (committed 24m reduces to ~36k/month).
- On-prem appliance (single node, 80GB memory / T4-equivalent inference): one-time setup + managed install $95k, or monthly managed service $9k/month if you prefer.

Attachments: Draft_SOW_NovaGen_v1.2.pdf, topology_analytics_vpc.png, cost_summary_Q3.xlsx

Next steps: Monica will attach formal pricing and legal will include an amendment template. Can we do a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk the SOW? If that works, propose 10am ET.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@novagen.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion ask ahead of renewal — analytics VPC + on-prem edge node

Adding initial pricing breakout and technical constraints.

Pricing (monthly, list -> 24m commit):
- Analytics VPC dedicated cluster (4x A100 equiv): list $45,000 -> commit 24m $36,000
- Network isolation and audit logging retention (30 days indexed): $1,200/month
- On-prem appliance + managed support (option A: one-time incl install): $95,000 one-time + $1,800/month support
- On-prem appliance (option B: no HW; Redwood-provided managed edge in NovaGen colo): $9,000/month (no upfront)

Technical notes:
- KMS/HSM: we support external KMS integrations (bring-your-own KMS). For an air-gapped site we require a vetted install runbook and in-person sign-off.
- Cache isolation: analytics cluster will be configured with disabled KV shard sharing and dedicated prefix caching.
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide audit logs and a recent SOC2 report; timeline for deeper evidence requests ~5 business days once legal has a list.

I'll attach a short cost_summary_Q3.xlsx with line items.

-Karthik
From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novagen.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion ask ahead of renewal — analytics VPC + on-prem edge node

Thanks Samira — looping in Kimberly (legal) to start an amendment + data processing appendix. Kimberly: please review the attached Draft_SOW_NovaGen_v1.2.pdf and provide any standard redlines. Procurement note: if NovaGen wants the 24-month commitment, we'll need confirmed headcount and usage bands for the analytics cluster to finalize the discounted tier. Samira — can procurement send the usage forecast (tokens/month, peak qps) by EOD Wed? That will let us lock the 24m pricing.

Also please confirm whether the on-prem node will be vendor-managed (Redwood installs, we ship appliance) or customer-managed (NovaGen supplies hardware + we provide install runbook). The preferred option changes lead times and billing.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Sr. Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@novagen.com>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novagen.com, ctomike@novagen.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion ask ahead of renewal — analytics VPC + on-prem edge node

Monica/Karthik/Vivek — thanks, this looks good and aligns with our internal ask. Procurement is comfortable with the 24-month commitment if the discount to $36k/month is documented and the SOW includes the SOC2 evidence window + KMS interface requirements.

We've attached (separately) a short usage forecast to procurement@redwood.com; peak tokens/month and expected burst windows are included. NovaGen prefers Redwood-managed on-prem appliance (ship + install) to reduce internal ops burden. Please add a managed-install clause and an SLA for the on-prem node in the SOW.

Next steps from our side: procurement will route the draft SOW/Amendment to legal and return redlines within 5 business days. If you can get the updated SOW (with managed install clause and finalized pricing tiers) and a DocuSign-ready amendment by Jul 27, we can hit our internal approval cadence.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I'll block time for a short sign-off call the morning of Jul 28 if you need it.

Best,
Samira
---- End of thread ----
